channel.title: Wholesale and retail: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the wholesale and retail sector.

item.title: Wooyang P&L: Wooyang P&L reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 34.2bn and operating profit of KRW 3.5bn, provisional figures.
Hansaemk: Hansaemk resolves third-party allotment of 10,455,564 new shares at KRW 1,339 to majority shareholder in debt-to-equity conversion.
E-mart: E-mart's October 2026 standalone net sales were KRW 1,398.4bn, down 3.5% year on year; gross sales fell 4.5%.
E-mart: E-Mart reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 7.49tn and operating profit of KRW 46.1bn, down 69.6% year on year.
Savezone I&C: Save Zone I&C reported Q3 2026 revenue of KRW 31.2bn and an operating loss of KRW 1.8bn, with a net loss of KRW 20.1bn.
Shinsegae International: Shinsegae International reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 299.5bn and operating profit of KRW 5.1bn, versus a loss a year earlier.
SKNetworksCompanyLimited: SK Networks reported Q3 2026 preliminary consolidated revenue of KRW 1,935.7bn and operating profit of KRW 20.1bn, with a net loss of KRW 0.5bn.
SG: SG Semul Corp reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 36.8bn and an operating loss of KRW 1.2bn, with a net loss of KRW 1.0bn.
